summary: Unidentified man killed in speed-flying canopy crash above Breckenridge; launched from Peak 6 at Breckenridge Ski Resort; reported missing Saturday morning by a friend; found by Summit County Rescue Group with helicopter assistance, canopy entangled with the broken-off top of a tree; name not released
notes: Date approximate: article published 2022-08-28, victim reported missing Saturday morning; crash likely Friday or Saturday - 2022-08-27 used. Speed-flying = canopy descent, recorded as incident_type=other. Run 880.
